Title: Public preview: Azure Automanage now supports Arc enabled servers

Body.Content:
Azure Automanage is now available to Azure Arc customers. If you're using Azure Arc to connect your servers into Azure from anywhere in the world, you can now automatically apply best practices services on your servers by onboarding them onto Azure Automanage. You no longer have to worry about the details of onboarding and maintaining best practice management services such as Monitoring and Update Management on your Arc servers since Automanage can now do that for you.

This addition of Arc support will join the current public preview of Azure Automanage and is available for all Azure public cloud customers today. 

Learn more.
